phase_clock: monotonic; rate/base_cycle_seconds; no reset on updates
steady_phase_cycles: steps 1..10, or ongoing when steps is zero
update_policy: Latest target coalesced until current transition completes; original command retains cycle count
stance_policy: Reference XY fixed in world until lift-off; sole minimum Z equals ground
swing_policy: Quintic position; endpoint fixed at lift-off; cubic-product lift bump
stop_policy: Speed zero; reduce stride then finish active swings; no new command resurrects a stopping state
